title: EcoTrack local complete ER model
description: Solid relationships are declared FKs. Dashed relationships are logical associations. External entities are selected reference projections, not complete provider schemas. Cardinalities follow nullable references and unconditioned key uniqueness; partial uniqueness is documented in the dictionary.

diagrams.title: EcoTrack local schema
diagrams.source:
erDiagram
  %% Solid = declared FK; dashed = selected logical reference (no FK).
  %% PK/UK markers on multiple fields can be components of one tuple; see dictionary.
  %% External auth/public projections list selected reference fields only.
  sqlite_cloud_sync_state {
    TEXT source PK
    TEXT cursor_created
    TEXT cursor_id
  }
  sqlite_monitor_calibrations {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT node_id FK
    TEXT valid_from
    REAL temperature_offset_c
    TEXT notes
    INTEGER field_calibrated
    TEXT created_at
  }
  sqlite_monitor_changed_nodes {
    TEXT node_id PK
    INTEGER version
  }
  sqlite_monitor_nodes {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT name
    TEXT aircon_id
    TEXT aircon_name
    TEXT location
    TEXT state_source
    REAL expected_interval_seconds
    INTEGER active
    TEXT token_hash
    TEXT created_at
    TEXT updated_at
    TEXT aircon_type
    TEXT registry_node_id
    INTEGER registry_retired
  }
  sqlite_monitor_revision {
    INTEGER id PK
    TEXT generation
    INTEGER version
  }
  sqlite_monitor_samples {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT node_id UK, FK
    TEXT aircon_id
    TEXT aircon_name
    TEXT observed_at
    TEXT received_at
    TEXT boot_id UK
    INTEGER sequence UK
    INTEGER uptime_ms
    REAL interval_seconds
    TEXT clock_quality
    REAL raw_temperature_c
    REAL outlet_temperature_c
    INTEGER ac_on
    TEXT state_source
    TEXT temperature_quality
    TEXT calibration_id FK
    TEXT payload_hash
    TEXT sensor_name
    TEXT location
    TEXT aircon_type
    REAL battery_voltage
    REAL rssi_dbm
    TEXT connection_status
    TEXT operating_mode
    REAL rotation_rpm
    TEXT rotation_quality
    TEXT control_snapshot
  }
  sqlite_monitor_sync_outbox {
    INTEGER id PK
    TEXT table_name
    TEXT object_id
    TEXT payload
  }
  sqlite_monitor_sync_status {
    INTEGER id PK
    TEXT last_success
    TEXT error
  }
  sqlite_schedule_dispatches {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT node_id
    TEXT ip
    INTEGER interval_seconds
    TEXT status
    TEXT error
    TEXT created
    TEXT updated
  }
  sqlite_sensor_schedules {
    TEXT node_id PK, FK
    TEXT wake_time
    TEXT sleep_time
    INTEGER interval_seconds
    TEXT updated_at
  }
  sqlite_telemetry {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT node_id
    TEXT sensor_name
    TEXT room_name
    TEXT floor_name
    TEXT building_name
    TEXT aircon_type
    REAL temperature
    REAL battery
    REAL rssi
    TEXT status
    TEXT created
    TEXT updated
    TEXT event_type
    INTEGER interval_seconds
    TEXT wake_time
    TEXT sleep_time
    INTEGER ac_on
    TEXT aircon_id
    TEXT control_snapshot
    TEXT ac_state
    REAL rotation_rpm
    TEXT rotation_quality
    TEXT observed_at
    TEXT boot_id
    INTEGER sequence
  }
  sqlite_telemetry_backup_state {
    INTEGER id PK
    TEXT last_success
    REAL completed_epoch
    TEXT filename
    TEXT error
  }
  sqlite_telemetry_cloud_receipts {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT payload
    TEXT cleaned_at
  }
  sqlite_telemetry_history_generation {
    INTEGER id PK
    TEXT token
  }
  sqlite_telemetry_local_reset {
    INTEGER id PK
    TEXT deleted_through
  }
  sqlite_telemetry_monitor_sources {
    TEXT source_id PK
    TEXT node_id
    TEXT payload
  }
  public_aircons {
    text id PK
  }
  public_nodes {
    text id PK
  }
  sqlite_monitor_nodes ||--o{ sqlite_monitor_calibrations : "node_id"
  sqlite_monitor_calibrations ||--o{ sqlite_monitor_samples : "calibration_id"
  sqlite_monitor_nodes ||--o{ sqlite_monitor_samples : "node_id"
  sqlite_monitor_nodes |o--o| sqlite_sensor_schedules : "node_id"
  public_nodes |o..o{ sqlite_telemetry : "node_id REF no FK"
  public_aircons |o..o{ sqlite_telemetry : "aircon_id REF no FK"
  public_aircons |o..o{ sqlite_monitor_nodes : "aircon_id REF no FK"
  public_nodes |o..o{ sqlite_monitor_nodes : "registry_node_id REF no FK"
  public_aircons |o..o{ sqlite_monitor_samples : "aircon_id REF no FK"
  sqlite_monitor_nodes |o..o{ sqlite_monitor_changed_nodes : "node_id REF no FK"
  sqlite_telemetry |o..o{ sqlite_telemetry_cloud_receipts : "id REF no FK"
  sqlite_telemetry |o..o{ sqlite_telemetry_monitor_sources : "source_id REF no FK"
  public_nodes |o..o{ sqlite_telemetry_monitor_sources : "node_id REF no FK"
